Encounter.Name: First Contact
Encounter.DescriptionText: On the edge of your territory, a Syndicate base opens up like a hive of scum and villainy. Its operators send you this message:

Message.Text:
Dearest SING friends,
We are so happy that you have found us. Or rather, that you have allowed us to find you! Times are hard out here on the lonely frontier, and when times get hard, the Orion Syndicate gets to work.
So here is our proposal. You pay us 250 credits right now, and we promise a certain level of protection for your SING ships. If you decline, well, we cannot make any promises.
And whichever you choose, stay out of our space.
Regards, Harcourt Fenton Mudd, Independent Trader and Gentleman (acting on behalf of the Orion Syndicate)

Response.Text: Agree to pay 250 credits to this upstanding gentleman.

Message.Text: Wonderful news! We will let you know when we have drunk our way through your money. Until then, sleep safe.
Now that is disappointing. And here I was thinking we would be fast friends. It is your funeral, SING. Do your people have funerals? Never mind. The point is, we are coming for you.
Is this some kind of SING humour? You do not have the credits. That is not our problem. We are coming for you. If you want to buy us off, just hail my ship.
